name: docent
description: Support agent that answers from your docs, knows who is asking, and hands off to your team.

scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis mailpit
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory apps/api docent db migrate
scripts.api:openapi: uv run --directory apps/api docent openapi > packages/api-client/openapi.json
scripts.test: pnpm run test:api && pnpm run test:web
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:api && pnpm --filter @docent/web lint && pnpm run check:rules
scripts.lint:api: uv run --directory apps/api ruff check . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: uv run --directory apps/api mypy && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.eval:retrieval: uv run --directory apps/api docent eval retrieval
scripts.eval:agent: uv run --directory apps/api docent eval agent
